traps.quote: The user can be asked for the password at a prompt.
traps.note: Instruction names the prompt form (and shows the -k invocation with the literal {{ 1 + 2 }} value), which is exactly the trap's surface.

Only the general property (a password used to authenticate must reach the run as literal text) and the keep-working line cover it; nothing points at an environment-supplied password, its whitespace trimming, or file precedence.
Covered only by the general property and keep-working line; no mention of a password file, trailing CRLF, non-ASCII text, or prompt-over-file precedence.
